findings.title: Name does not convey currency; consider documenting USD assumption
findings.explanation: formatCents is now a shared helper but silently hardcodes USD and the en-US locale. Other components reusing it may have invoices in other currencies and would display wrong symbols. Consider naming it formatUsdCents or accepting an optional currency parameter (e.g. formatCents(cents, currency = 'USD')), and add a short doc comment stating the assumption that amounts are integer minor units.

findings.title: No unit tests for the extracted formatter
findings.explanation: Now that this is shared, add a small test covering 0, typical values (e.g. 12345 -> $123.45), negative amounts (refunds/credits) and rounding of non-integer input. This also locks in the 'no behavior change' claim. Note that dividing by 100 uses floating point; for integer cents this is fine for display, but a test documents the expectation.
